q: What is the process called that ensures the continuation of life on earth?
e: Process called that ensures the continuation of life on earth is Reproduction. Reproduction makes a new generation so the species can continue. Development is a different claim from Reproduction.

q: What type of reproduction involves the production of new individuals from a single parent without involving gametes?
e: Asexual reproduction is the right choice here. Reproduction makes a new generation so the species can continue. Sexual reproduction is a different claim from Asexual reproduction.

q: Which of the following is NOT a method of asexual reproduction?
e: Fertilization is the option that does not belong with the rest. Fertilization is the joining of male and female gametes. Budding is among the listed items, so it is not the exception.

q: During which process does a parent organism split to form two new organisms?
e: Fission is the right choice here. Fission is the idea that completes this fact. Budding is a different claim from Fission.

q: What is the term for the small part that grows out from the parent organism in budding?
e: Term for the small part that grows out from the parent organism in budding is Bud. Bud is the idea that completes this fact. Fragment is a different claim from Bud.

q: Which of the following is a method of asexual reproduction that involves the breaking up of the parent organism into fragments?
e: Fragmentation is a method of asexual reproduction that involves the breaking up of the parent organism into fragments. Fragmentation is the idea that completes this fact. Budding is not a method of asexual reproduction that involves the breaking up of the parent organism into fragments.

q: What are the microscopic reproductive units produced by parent plants during spore formation called?
e: The microscopic reproductive units produced by parent plants during spore formation called are Spores. Spores is the idea that completes this fact. Gametes is a different claim from Spores.

q: In vegetative propagation, new plants are obtained from which parts of the old plants?
e: Roots, stems, or leaves is the right choice here. Roots, stems, or leaves is the idea that completes this fact. Flowers is a different claim from Roots, stems, or leaves.

q: Which method of vegetative propagation involves cutting a part of the plant and allowing it to grow roots?
e: Cutting is method of vegetative propagation involves cutting a part of the plant and allowing it to grow roots. Cutting is the idea that completes this fact. Grafting is a different claim from Cutting.

q: What is the process called when two parent plants combine their gametes to produce a new organism?
e: Process called when two parent plants combine their gametes to produce a new organism is Sexual reproduction. Sexual reproduction joins gametes from two parents and mixes genes. Asexual reproduction is a different claim from Sexual reproduction.

q: What is inheritance?

q: What is the basic physical and functional unit of heredity?

q: What is the term for the fixed number of chromosomes in a species?
